item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In April 2023, the Union sought to establish a Bundestag investigative committee examining political responsibility for the Hamburg Cum-Ex scandal, including Olaf Scholz’s role; the article states that, while Hamburg finance authorities failed to reclaim tax refunds improperly paid to Warburg Bank when Scholz was Hamburg’s First Mayor, the matter had already been examined by two Hamburg parliamentary committees and Scholz had been questioned by the Bundestag Finance Committee in 2020.","notes":["The excerpt says “the Union,” not specifically the CDU."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In October 2023, Amnesty International submitted a briefing to the UN Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination stating that Germany was failing to meet Convention obligations concerning systemic racism, racial discrimination, racist violence by state actors, protection from non-state racist violence, and truth, justice, and reparations, despite some progress.","notes":["The excerpt describes a briefing submitted in advance of the Committee’s consideration; “told” was narrowed to “submitted a briefing.”"]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Destatis reported that, at 31 December 2023, the Ausländerzentralregister recorded 13,895,865 foreign persons and 3,173,135 protection seekers resident in Germany; the final protection-seeker count was approximately 55,000 higher than the raw-data count because of methodological developments, particularly concerning the better delineation of protection seekers from Ukraine.","notes":["The excerpt identifies the Ausländerzentralregister, not a general population register.","The comparison is with a raw-data count, not explicitly a preliminary count."]}]}
